description: Boot block entry consisting of a single instruction that calls one unnamed routine. The decompiler timed out, so nothing further is shown.

name: invoke_unnamed_routine_once
description: Seven-instruction routine whose address is taken by a PC-relative load. Two routines call it, and it calls one unnamed routine.

name: return_without_action
description: Routine whose shown body is only a return, so it does no work in the pseudo-code. Other routines call it.

name: store_fixed_constant_and_return
description: Stores a fixed 32-bit constant into a global variable and returns. The decompiler shows only that store and the return.

name: call_routine_then_set_flag
description: Calls one unnamed routine, then sets a global flag to one if it is currently zero, and returns. The decompiler shows no other operations.

name: store_fixed_constant_and_return
description: Stores a fixed 32-bit constant into a global variable and returns. The decompiler shows only that store and the return.

name: advance_audio_channel_sequence
description: Advances a step counter and, on every sixth step, loads values from a table into per-channel state and writes the four audio location registers, with a fixed-count wait in between. It calls two unnamed routines and was reached from outside the static flow in the reference run.

name: update_audio_channel_period
description: Adjusts a channel value by a byte step, increasing or decreasing it depending on a mode nibble, clamps it to a fixed range, and writes it to the audio channel register. It also touches the audio length and location registers and the DMA control register.
